sugarR.title: Sugar → feeding
sugarR.about: Sugar-sensing taste neurons drive MN9, the motor neuron that extends the proboscis.

waterR.title: Water → feeding
waterR.about: Water-sensing taste neurons reach the same proboscis motor neuron by a different route.

antenna.title: Antenna touch → grooming
antenna.about: Touch sensors in the antenna drive aDN1, aDN2 and aBN1, which make the fly groom its antennae.
